Pick up Professor Splattunfuder’s recipe book of disaster with 101 Ways to Die now 40% off on Steam!

101 Ways to Die is a physics based puzzle platformer with more murderous mayhem and treacherous tricks than the average laboratory could handle… But thank god Splattenfuder laid the ground work for all your devious, deadly and destructive desires! Wipe out Splatts with bombs, spikes, boulders, giant swinging logs, harpoons… and every kind of weapon you can imagine, probably! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11973363/d2c7628fc4120b5a3bd4dd18082ddfb11f5e006a.png

Fill up the recipe book by coming up with brand new and unique traps and set ups to put as many Splatts to death as you can. It’ll take all kinds of creative chaos to discover all the possibilities - only the greatest gorey minds need apply!

You only have until 6th September to grab 101 Ways to Die with 40% off, so don’t miss out on this golden opportunity to let rip and put your own cruel creativity to the test.

notes.title: Game up-date - fixes bugs and improves stability
notes.content:
After some great feed-back from our community, we have released an up-date to fix some start-up and in-game bugs. Thank you and continue the slaughter!

- Game start up now checks both adaptor and monitors for valid resolutions to set the game to (including validating settings from a previous save)
- Added Steam Error mini dump reporting hooks into the separate threads to catch any proper crashes
- Added some software exceptions:
DX11 CreateDevice functions
Array bounds checking
Memory block allocation 
DX11 Create vertex/Index Buffer functions
DX11 Swapchain Acquire Resources functions
DX11 Swapchain creation functions
- NDEBUG defined now so any crashes are reported 
- Fixed Issue with keyboard key repeating when not pressed down when input had been buffered.
